page_title: LYO 4-1 NIC | Lyon v Nice 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Tom Louchet (Nice) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+5' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lyon.
90+1' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+1' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
87' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will take the corner.
87' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Marcin Bulka makes a simple save.
86' The goalkeeper pulls off a wonder save to deny the first-time effort from Evann Guessand (Nice).
84' Substitution. Sofiane Diop did his best and is replaced by Rares Ilie (Nice).
83' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Hicham Boudaoui and he is replaced by Issiaga Camara (Nice).
83' Substitution. Corentin Tolisso is replaced by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon).
79' Sofiane Diop (Nice) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
78' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
77' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Malick Fofana will be replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
77' The foul by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
76' Tom Louchet (Nice) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
73' Here comes a substitution. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Tanguy Ndombele.
73' Today's match ends for Yael Nandjou who will be replaced by Amidou Doumbouya (Nice).
71' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) replaces Alexandre Lacazette.
71' Substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) on for Duje Caleta-Car.
69' 4 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Marcin Bulka no chance!
69' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
69' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
67' There's a break in play and referee Bastien Dechepy must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lyon using VAR. This could be interesting!
67' Surely that's handball by one of the Nice players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
66' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Lyon have a corner.
65' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
65' What a big chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
63' Pablo Rosario (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
61' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Lucas Perri stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
60' Sofiane Diop (Nice) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
54' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Nice! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Bastien Dechepy and both teams have no complaints.
49' Referee Bastien Dechepy makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
48' Evann Guessand (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Half-time substitution. Pierre Sage decided to make a change. Said Benrahma (Lyon) is replaced by Rayan Cherki.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+4' Problems for Franck Haise as Mohamed-Ali Cho is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Badredine Bouanani (Nice) replaces him.
45+4' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
45+1' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

43' 3 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Jordan Veretout (Lyon) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Marcin Bulka. 3:1.

41' 2 - 1 Goal! Said Benrahma manages to prod the ball to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
41' Said Benrahma (Lyon) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
39' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Lyon.
36' Moise Bombito (Nice) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Yael Nandjou with a fine lofted pass.
34' Said Benrahma (Lyon) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

28' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Marcin Bulka, who pulls off a comfortable save!
27' Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Now Nice have a corner.
26' Pablo Rosario (Nice) releases Tanguy Ndombele, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
22' 1 - 1 Mohamed-Ali Cho feeds the ball through to Sofiane Diop (Nice), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!
19' Malick Fofana (Lyon) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
16' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
15' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Clinton Mata darts into free space to control the ball.
13' Sofiane Diop (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
10' The Nice players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Bastien Dechepy signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a foul.
9' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Nice players aren’t happy.
7' Evann Guessand (Nice) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!

4' 1 - 0 Clinton Mata sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
